name: Tom McKitterick
biography: Tom McKitterick was born on December 20, 1956. He is an actor, known for The Warriors (1979). After doing The Warriors (1979) and some stage work, McKitterick left the business in 1981. He became a photojournalist and was represented by Impact Visuals, a progressive agency in New York. Eventually, in addition to news, he shot sports...tennis, in particular. McKitterick enjoyed a decade of shooting grand slams, Masters and Davis Cup. After twenty years as a successful photojournalist (covering sports and other news), he returned to show business...theater, to be exact. He is currently producing Period Of Adjustment, a play by Tennessee Williams, in conjunction with the Almeida Theatre in London. McKitterick hopes to land it on Broadway in the fall of 2006. [September 2005]
